svg.title: D · Per-task execution

svg.text: One durable intent and logical execution identity; observing work is not launching work.
Cancellation/deadline can also enter Cancel requested from a known running execution. Unknown -> settled may bypass cancellation when
authoritative terminal/fence proof arrives. Neither route proves exposure zero.
Proved never dispatched: release reservation if closing the intent; any later launch needs authority. Changed inputs/scope require a new
immutable task. Uncertain dispatch consumes one invocation, not one per observation.

Cheap observation is not another task
Wait wakes re-enter verification first; they can accept already available evidence without another model call. Unchanged polling writes no
new history. Boundary acceptance prepares a new scoped invocation through D.

svg.title: F · Hold, stopping and reconciliation
svg.desc: Concurrent controls retain the stage; independent protection remains available if ACED or agents fail.. Development-preview state chart; descriptive conditions are not additional public development stages. Transition guards are specified in the companion document.
svg.text: Concurrent controls retain the stage; independent protection remains available if ACED or agents fail.
Hold remains set during stop or failure recovery. Safety observation, stop delivery, reconciliation and required cleanup continue. Whether
held runs may accept a finished ordinary handoff is still an explicit design question.
Persist cause; operator stop is sticky
E / R11: protected active work can
Use this cleanup path when facts/policy require stopping or failed-attempt settlement. Uncertainty alone stays in D/E observation and may
resolve to a protected active operation. Shutdown, cancellation or timeout does not prove zero.
